action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Expat, vendored in CableSwig, incorrectly handled
certain files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash
or execute arbitrary code.
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in CableSwig.
